data.title: As students rely on AI in the college search, admissions offices scramble to keep up | CNN Business
data.description: The college admissions essay is in a very weird place. It’s impossible to say just how many of them are now written by AI, but at this point, experts agree that it’s a lot of them. And while colleges generally frown upon that practice, they’re using AI to evaluate the essays, too.
data.author: Ramishah Maruf
